Team — handing this one over after signatures. High level and immediate asks below; attaching the signed SOW and the draft deployment checklist for quick reference (attachments: Aurora_SOW_v1.pdf, aurora_deployment_checklist.xlsx).

Deal quick facts:
- Customer: Aurora Health (enterprise ambulatory network)
- ARR: $325k committed first year (includes 12M tokens/mo + dedicated capacity)
- Product: Redwood Dedicated (reserved capacity), private VPC peering, SAML SSO
- Contract start: 2028-04-15; preferred kickoff week: 2028-04-18
- Primary customer contacts: Ben Turner (IT Ops) + Lina Morales (Security/Compliance)

What matters and known constraints:
- Aurora requires SOC 2 evidence and a short security questionnaire answered by EOD 3/29 (Lina will send).
- They want VPC peering in us-west-2 and strict IP allowlist; networking team needs to coordinate with their network engineer for IP ranges and peering windows.
- Initial scope: model serving for two diagnostic-assist endpoints + embeddings for patient search. Expect steady 100 rps burst to 600 rps — provisioning guidance in checklist.
- They asked for a prefail-safe: fallback to smaller model variant if latency > 300ms for 99th pct. We should document supported model variants and expected latency targets per our runtime profiles.

Immediate handoff asks (owner / ETA):
1) Schedule 90-min kickoff (owner: Marissa) — propose 2 options next week (4/18 or 4/20). Include Ben and Lina, SME from Infra + Security.
2) Fill deployment checklist with contact emails, network windows, and expected traffic pattern (owner: Tessa) — due 4/1.
3) Security questionnaire response (owner: Karthik to coordinate with Security team) — draft due 3/29.
4) Implementation runbook & access matrix (owner: Marissa) — initial draft by 4/5.

Risks to call out to CS:
- Dedicated capacity will be provisioned on a schedule; lead time ~10 business days after network confirmation.
- SOC evidence review may request additional logs; keep a week buffer before production cutover.

Notes from sales conversations: customer is price-sensitive but wants predictable latency for clinician workflows. They selected Redwood because of the Dedicated/reserved capacity guarantees and our routing/fallback story.

Attachments:
- Aurora_SOW_v1.pdf (executed SOW)
- aurora_deployment_checklist.xlsx (draft — please update)

Thanks — I’ll be available for the kickoff prep and can sit in on the first 30–45 minutes to introduce.
